name: The Caribbean
description: Warm shallows, rival crews and Navy patrols. Every pirate starts here.

name: The Atlantic Crossing
description: Open ocean and Navy convoys. Long days between landfalls.

name: The West African Coast
description: Slaver country. Ugly work, but every captive freed is a hand gained.

name: The Cape of Storms
description: Where two oceans meet and fight. Company ships round the Cape heavy with cargo.

name: The Indian Ocean
description: The Company's trade routes, and the pirate havens that feed on them.

name: The Spice Islands
description: Rich, crowded waters. Company factories and rival crews fighting over the spoils.

name: The South China Sea
description: The Company's home waters, and its flagship.
